text_block_list.text:
...I lost. It figures that Ryan would beat
me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Her drive to dominate the Classics
slightly
surpassed my own.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
However, I must not continue with my
head hung
low!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I will feel this shame. I will scold myself.
But then,
I shall stand back up and move
forward!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Let us go and discuss how we can adjust
my
training regimen moving forward!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for putting up a real fight,
McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll continue to get stronger
and
stronger from here on out.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I won't lose next time, either!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho finished, there is
little left to
do this year.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Soon after we welcome in the new year,
it will be
time for—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
My number one objective... I will show
everyone
the culmination of all my hard
work!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин's fiery determination is

palpable, her eyes fixed firmly on what
lies
ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
